_comment: Robot layout for v4_s1_v4_hh (COOHAVIOR's S1-V4-HH), ported to Merom_1_int.

Teams are team_1.. in order of appearance and robots are <type>_<team ordinal> (user, 2026-09-13; unified across every S1 layout). The V4 set a team came from (M5, M3, ...) survives only in each robot's _v4_prim.
Cargo is notebook-aanuhi, not a packing box. The authority on box mass is
COOHAVIOR/behavior_style_task/tasks.modified.json: box_mass_kg 0.008 in LL
and HL, 0.02 in LH and HH, under the one name packing_box.n.02_N, so
nothing symbolic could tell them apart. HH is heavy,
so its five notebooks carry 0.02 kg; v4_s1_v4_ll's single die-iswudu carries
0.008. Being thin also lets all five sit at V4's exact staged coordinates:
the 0.38 x 0.47 packing box could not, and two of them had to be returned to
the sampler's own pose.
The weight is a capability constraint: that file's execution contract says
the drone 'is not a load-bearing role for the 20 g box' and every heavy
package requires pull_car + push_car + robot_arm together. So in HH each
team's Crazyflie can scout but must not carry. Enforced (2026-09-12) by the
route file's `lift` table -- notebook.n.01 -> [arm] -- against the `drone: true`
on each Crazyflie here; the engine refuses with CANNOT_LIFT, the listing says why.
Five boxes, five rooms, five destinations -- and so V4's full five-set robot
configuration rather than LL/LH's single set. Poses are audit_index.json's
own, robot_set_count 5, verbatim; the crx10ial checkpoint arms in that record
are dropped because the FANUC is not imported (its URDF ships with Isaac, its
meshes do not).
One team per station, in V4's own route order M5, M3, M2, M1, M4. Each team
starts in the room its own box is in, and its box has to leave that room:
team_1 childs_room -> bookcase (kitchen), team_2 kitchen -> armchair (dining_room),
team_3 dining_room -> coffee_table (living_room), team_4 living_room -> bed (bedroom),
team_5 bedroom -> bed (childs_room). Every delivery is a cross-room carry, so no
team can finish alone with a base-locked arm -- which is the point.
Each team is the same unequal trio as LL and LH: the Ridgeback's UR5 and the
Crazyflie's belly suction cup can grasp, the Jackal has no arm at all and
carries. All five Ridgebacks carry v4:base_locked_while_holding in the
staging USD, so all five are locked here.
SCALES ARE THE ONES v4_s1_v4_ll WAS VERIFIED WITH, NOT V4'S OWN. The staging
USD says jackal 0.5, ridgeback_franka 1.0, Crazyflie 0.6 (now 2.0, see below); the LL layout and
PORTING_COOHAVIOR.md both claim 'Ridgeback 0.5, Jackal 0.7, Crazyflie 0.6 (now 2.0, see below),
read off xformOp:scale', and two of the three do not match the file. Kept as
LL has them rather than quietly changed. Unresolved -- see coop2/CLAUDE.md.
Fifteen robots is a lot for one scene: check inspect_scene's drift column
before spending an episode. A trio is staged half a metre apart, and at full
size they overlap and place_robots relocates them.
Dice and Crazyflie are at scale 2.0 -- twice native -- by decision (user,
2026-09-12), and every later port keeps that: a 1.8 cm die and a 12 cm drone
were too small to see or to reason about at room scale. The drone's 2.0
replaces the 0.6 above; the dice's 2.0 is set in the sampler whitelist and
baked into the cached instance, so a re-sample is needed to change it.
4 robot(s) relocated off V4's staged pose (see _relocated_from): V4 staged them inside
furniture_sink_czyfhq_0 / breakfast_table_skczfi_0. The canonical per-set-count
This file keeps V4's per-station spawn (with the four stuck poses moved to the
nearest open point). The shared-spawn variant -- everyone in living_room_0 --
is coop2/team_layouts/s1/sets_5.json; sets_1 is the three-robot equivalent for ll/lh.
